scenario: Blank lines don't affect indentation tracking per LLEX.5.3 — blank lines inside an actions block (between `->` and actions) do not trigger a DEDENT and don't cause a parse error. The lexer treats them as non-existent for indentation purposes.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->

    log info "ok"
